relations: Steady horizontal planks with soil on the right support drifting sharp leaf shadows from overhead foliage.
A dissolve transition fades out close-up shadows and soil, revealing a wider top-down view of decking.
In the wider shot, grass borders both sides while softer dappled leaf patterns shift slightly.
The ongoing motion is the changing play of light and shadow on the wood.
caption: A sunlit wooden walkway of horizontal planks with narrow gaps fills the frame, patterned by sharp leaf shadows. In this close-up the boards and camera remain steady while the leaf shapes drift, and bare soil with a curved root and green sprouts borders the right. Partway through, a visible dissolve changes the framing: the close-up shadows and soil fade out as a wider top-down view fades in, briefly superimposed. The new shot settles on a longer stretch of decking bordered by grass on both sides, its shadows softer and dappled. Here the view remains largely steady, with only the leaf patterns shifting slightly. No person or object crosses the boards. Apart from the dissolve, the ongoing motion is the changing play of light and shadow on the wood.
